f.title: Post-opinion, send the redacted RMP body and Annexes 4 and 6 as one PDF via EudraLink with the redaction file and the signed publication declaration
f.statement: All RMPs assessed in initial MA procedures with a positive opinion after 20 October 2023 are published in full (body, Annex 4 and Annex 6) after the Commission Decision. Post-opinion, the MAH will be asked to extract the RMP body and Annexes 4 and 6 (as applicable, redacting personal data and commercially confidential information) as one stand-alone PDF and send it via EudraLink to the EMA, with an RMP file showing the content proposed for redaction and the signed RMP Publication Declaration.
f.clause: 3.5.7 When and how will the RMP summary be published?
f.applicability: Initial MA procedures with a positive opinion after 20 October 2023

rows.quote:
All RMPs assessed in initial marketing authorization procedures receiving a positive Opinion after 20 October 2023 will have the full RMP (RMP body + Annex 4 + Annex 6) published after the adoption of the Commission Decision grating the MA.

Post-opinion, the MAH will be asked to extract the RMP body and Annexes 4 & 6 (as applicable, redacting personal data and commercial confidential information) as one stand-alone PDF document and send it via EudraLink to the EMA, together with a RMP file that can show the content that is proposed for redaction, and the signed RMP Publication Declaration
rows.location: 3.5.7 When and how will the RMP summary be published?
rows.review_note: Review: deadline: The quote states the time point ('Post-opinion'). The field was empty. title: The title left out the RMP file showing the content proposed for redaction, which the quote requires. Double-check: doubtful - 'the MAH will be asked to' is read as Mandatory, as in the post-authorisation review (will be requested). The first sentence of the statement is an Agency publication fact, not an MAH duty. It is kept only as context for applicability.

f.title: Describe an educational programme in RMP V.2 and its key messages in RMP Annex 6
f.statement: For an educational programme used as additional risk minimisation, the description of the programme is included in RMP V.2 (Additional Risk Minimisation Measures) and the key messages of the educational materials are included in RMP Annex 6. These are assessed as part of the MA application and reflected in Annex II.D of the marketing authorisation for centrally authorised products. Review of the educational materials incorporating these key elements is done at Member State level.

f.applicability: Initial marketing authorisation applications in the centralised procedure

rows.quote: The description of the educational program  is included in RMP V.2. Additional Risk Minimisation Measures , and the key messages of the educational materials are included in RMP Annex 6 , and will be assessed as part of the MA application and will be reflected in the Annex II.D of the marketing authorisation for centrally authorised medicinal products. Review of the educational materials incorporating these key elements is done at the Member State level.
rows.location: 3.5.11 How is the assessment of an educational program as additional risk minimisation handled?
data_elements: key messages of educational materials (RMP Annex 6)
rows.review_note: Review: quote: Extended to the sentence saying that the educational materials themselves are reviewed at Member State level. The statement needs this so it does not suggest EMA approves the materials. statement: Adds the Member State review, which limits what is assessed centrally. systems: Annex II.D is a part of the marketing authorisation, not a system. It is already named in the statement. data_elements: Names where each element goes. Double-check: doubtful - The source wording is descriptive ('is included', 'will be assessed') and has no modal. Recommended is an inference that follows the RMP template, and Mandatory is not supported. It is borderline as a requirement at all.

rows.review_note: Review: quote: Split. The second sentence ('should be submitted, through the appropriate variation, after the Commission Decision') is a separate 'should' duty, at a different time and through a different procedure, so it becomes a missing row. title: The row is now only the 'cannot be introduced' prohibition. statement: Split, so the row holds one duty. actor: The prohibition applies within the initial MAA procedure, before the MA is granted. Mandatory is defensible as a prohibition, but it is not one of the listed trigger words.
